def format_info(raw):
    """Format a string representing the information
    concerning the name.
    """
    raw_split = raw.split("\n")

    # The first line of the info contains the name
    name = raw_split[0]

    # The second line contains the information
    info = raw_split[1]

    # The third line contains the country
    country = raw_split[2]

    # The fourth line contains the type
    type = raw_split[3]

    # The fifth line contains the year
    year = raw_split[4]

    # The sixth line contains the population
    population = raw_split[5]

    # The seventh line contains the region
    region = raw_split[6]

    # The eighth line contains the area
    area = raw_split[7]

    # The ninth line contains the coordinates
    coordinates = raw_split[8]

    # The tenth line contains the elevation
    elevation = raw_split[9]

    # The eleventh line contains the timezone
    timezone = raw_split[10]

    # The twelfth line contains the capital
    capital = raw_split[11]

    # The thirteenth line contains the languages
    languages = raw_split[12]

    # The fourteenth line contains the currency
    currency = raw_split[13]

    # The fifteenth line contains the calling code
    calling_code = raw_split[14]

    return {
        "name": name,
        "info": info,
        "country": country,
        "type": type,
        "year": year,
        "population": population,
        "region": region,
        "area": area,
        "coordinates": coordinates,
        "elevation": elevation,
        "timezone": timezone,
        "capital": capital,
        "languages": languages,
        "currency": currency,
        "calling_code": calling_code
    }
